unstuck_said.text: Filed upstream Nano (XNO) settlement proposal as issue qntx/facilitator#102 (2026-09-26, as dhyabi2): add a nano:mainnet settlement module beside the EVM/SVM/TVM/AVM/Hedera rails. Framed in the repo own terms - per-CAIP2 [network.*] config already exists (schemes=["exact"], no rpc entry needed, no gas underwriting), verification is the one confirmed send block via public-node block_info (subtype=send, link_as_account=merchant nano_ address, received==sent), removes the underfunded-wallet funding floor. Live checkable reference: extract.paypercall.dev/.well-known/x402 serving network nano:mainn
